newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber in small deals, Bridgestone buys.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber in small deals, Bridgestone buys.

text.p: Trading in the Singapore rubber market was marked by small-lot deals with Bridgestone said to have bought a small amount of rubber in quiet dealings on Tuesday, dealers said.
"There were bits and pieces of business being done. I heard Bridgestone bought a small amount in the morning. Goodyear did not want to buy until the price is very attractive," a dealer said.
Another dealer said the weak performance of the Japanese rubber market and the upcoming summer holiday season kept most of the trade glued to the sidelines.
"A quiet Japan provided no leads in the market. People here are also afraid of rising production with the summer slowdown coming up," the dealer said.
"Some local dealers were also liquidating their positions in the market and pulling prices down as a result," a trader said.
Dealers said the market will probably drift lower over the next few days due to an absence of fresh leads.

At 0945 GMT, August RSS3 was seen at 111.00-113.00 U.S. cents a kg from 112.00 cents. July RSS1 was seen at 155.00-157.00 Singapore cents (US$1.09-$1.10) a kg from 157.00 cents. - (S$1.42 = US$1) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
